dct_description_sm: Map subtitles: India, agricultural regions & industrial centres. Drought & famine -- Irrigation -- Roads & railways -- Staple foods -- Population, 1931 -- Languages, 1931 -- Religions, 1941 -- Geographical regions -- Climatic regions.; Includes ill., ancillary maps of Bombay and Calcutta, location maps, and graphs showing crops, manufactures, mining, land utilization 1939-40, population, religions, and central and provincial government structures.; Sheet title and scope notes on verso of each sheet. Includes sheets 1-5.
72 x 84 centimeters or smaller, sheets 77 x 102 centimeters
